in_latin.name: Prudentia
in_latin.long_meaning: Prudentia is a name derived from the Latin word 'prudentia', meaning wisdom, discretion, or cautious. This name embodies the virtue of prudence, which is considered one of the four cardinal virtues in Christian tradition. It signifies the ability to govern and guide oneself and others through the use of reason and wisdom.

The name embodies the virtue of prudence, a cardinal virtue in Christian ethics. Historically, Prudencia has been associated with wisdom, sound judgment, and careful decision-making. In Christian tradition, Prudencia symbolizes a person of discerning spirit and moral integrity. The name has been borne by several saints, notably Saint Prudence, highlighting its significance in Christian heritage.
